program:
mini: a little functional language (numbers, truth values, functions, let, if) read, typed and run, over a corpus of programs and a batch of generated ones.
Prior art: type inference by algorithm W (Luis Damas and Robin Milner, "Principal type-schemes for functional programs", POPL 1982), after Hindley (1969) and Milner (1978).
Prior art: unification (J. A. Robinson, "A Machine-Oriented Logic Based on the Resolution Principle", JACM 12(1), 1965).
Textbook: an interpreter with closures as environments (Peter Landin, "The Mechanical Evaluation of Expressions", 1964); the generator's linear congruential generator is the C standard's example rand (ISO C, 1989).
